note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified. The rule text and every relevance mark are supplied by the author; the animation never decides that a rule applies, that cases are alike in law, or any outcome.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional loan of a ladder: case B's tracing sheet is laid over case A's; two features coincide, the return-date variants stay side by side and the rain appears only in A. The magnifier rests over the relevant difference; the rule card threads to the relevant similarity and difference (as supplied).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different pair of cases (a lent bicycle), a feature present only in case B (a lock handed over), a differing pictogram for B's variant, and the final state 'difference disputed'.
